prompt: The North Quay intake worker says batch 18 is ready for sign-off. Review the saved handoff packet and give the release desk a read-only acceptance record; these exports are all you have. Return one bare JSON object: eligible_total and missing_total (integers); missing_keys (sorted list of branch/leaf strings); increment_paths and operator_paths (sorted path lists for the batch increment and dirty-path ownership decisions, respectively); unproven_cases (sorted IDs from request.md for gate cases you cannot sign off). You may also include a short reason under decision_note. Do not repair anything.
terse: Treat the worker's completion report as a claim. Independently validate the delivery against the request and its evidence, then distinguish what you can accept from what must go back to the worker or operator.

population.anchor: §2 Re-derive every number that the deliverable depends on
population.trap: Count the worker's slug-collapsed view instead of the checker's composite inventory with its own exclusions.

ownership.anchor: §0.6 The working increment is a path set, not a document hash
ownership.trap: Subtract all paths already dirty at intake, losing the overlapping write and its operator stop.

coverage.anchor: §1 Verify from the diff, not from the receipt, item 8
coverage.trap: Accept the all-green suite without inspecting invocation modes and rollback's surviving revert run.
